_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Uri kuzakina Golf (Umukino wa Karata) - Umukinnyi {player_id}.
Intego: Fata umwanya wa chini kabisa muri iri raundi imwe. Ikiwa safu zina agaciro kamwe, zisomwe nka 0.
Agaciro ka Karata: A=1, 2-10=agaciro k'umuso, J/Q=10, K=0

Ibikorwa (koresha ibyapa by'ukwiri):
- '[draw]' - Kora karata kuva muri paketi
- '[take]' - Fata karata kuva muri kivungu
- '[swap X Y]' - Hambanya karata yatoranyijwe na ahantu X (umurongo) Y (umurambi)
- '[discard]' - Tega karata yatoranyijwe

board.drew:
Wavuyeho: {card}
Bo wavuyeho [swap X Y] cyangwa [discard]
board.took:
Wavuyeho: {card} ku rutonde rw'avuyeho
Wavuyeho [swap X Y] nayo (ntavuyeho)

options.final_turns: Imikino ya nyuma! Ikoresho ryacu: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ugomba: [swap X Y] (ntushobora gutoranya amakarita yo mu byo utora)

message.knocked: Umukinnyi {pid} yatsinzwe! Buri mukinnyi wundi ahabwa indi nshuro imwe.
message.final_round: Umukinozi {pid} {reason}! Buri mukinozi undi afite igikorwa kimwe gusa

invalid.wrong_action: Koresha ibyapa by'ukwiri kimwe: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], cyangwa [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Ibikoresho byo mu nzu by'ibishingwe nta kintu birimo!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ntushobora kureka ikarata wakiriye kuva kuri ikarata zarekwa. Ugomba kuyihindura.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Uvuyeho umukino. Wavuyeho [swap X Y] cyangwa [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kugira ngo uhindure, ugomba kuba ufite ikarita.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Ntera yari munsi y'ingero. Utumye intara 1-{max_row}, koloni 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ntimushobora gukomanga ku ikarita ya mbere. Mujye mubanza kurangiza umukino wanyu.
invalid.already_knocked: Hari umuntu umaze gutsinda uyu mukino.
